item.title: The New World vs. World Borderlands Map Beta Is Live!
item.dc:creator: The Guild Wars 2 Team
item.description:
Be among the first to battle on the new Ascalon-themed WvW map and help shape its development with your feedback!

Read More
item.content:encoded:
Greetings, Guild Wars 2 community,

The wait is over! Our first beta test for the new World vs. World borderlands map begins today!

Inspired by Ascalon before and during the Searing, this new battlefield brings one of Tyria’s most iconic locations into World vs. World. For the duration of the beta, all borderlands maps have been temporarily replaced with the new map, giving everyone plenty of opportunities to explore and face off in battle. The beta runs through December 8.

Jump In and Help Shape the Map!

As we shared in our previous blog, this is a very early look at the map. It’s still in a gray-box state, with unfinished art, and plenty of room for changes based on what we learn from your playtesting.

For this first beta, we’re particularly interested in how the map feels to play. How does it feel to navigate? Are objectives placed in interesting locations? Where are fights happening, and how does the terrain affect combat?

Whether you’re commanding a squad or roaming solo, we want to hear about your experiences. Head over to the official World vs. World forums to share your feedback and help us make this new battlefield the best it can be.

More World vs. World Updates

Alongside the new map beta, we’re also rolling out several other updates to World vs. World.

The new War Score system, which we’ve been testing with the community, is officially coming out of beta. We’ve made additional scoring adjustments to put more emphasis on PvP interactions (kills and revives), while defending and upgrading objectives continues to reward players for actively contributing to their team’s success. The updated scoring will take effect with the WvW reset on Friday, November 13. We’ll continue monitoring the system and making adjustments as needed.

We’re also officially releasing the new skirmish and match reward systems. Skirmish rewards are available starting today, while match rewards will begin with the November 13 reset.

Finally, we’re introducing a few quality-of-life improvements, including streamlined auto-loot in WvW and a new “Upgrade All” button for WvW abilities.

You can find the full details in today’s release notes.

We’ll See You in the Mists!

We’re looking forward to seeing how the map plays once thousands of players get their hands on it. Thank you for being part of this process and helping us shape the future of World vs. World.

Now rally your guild, jump into the Mists, and let the battles begin!

—The Guild Wars 2 Team

item.title: Champion a Noble Cause with the Extra Life 2026 Donation Bundle
item.dc:creator: The Guild Wars 2 Team
item.description:
The Black Lion Chests have been updated with new items, and don't miss out on our weekly discounts!

Read More
item.content:encoded:
2026 Extra Life Donation Bundle

    ArenaNet is back to the Extra Life campaign this year with a new bundle! The 2026 Extra Life Donation Bundle can be bought for 800 gems and will be available until December 1.

    It contains the following items:

    • 5 Extra Life Karma Boosters
    • 5 Temporary Selfless Potions
    • 1 Extra Life Balloon

    The Extra Life 2025 Donation Bundle has also returned for 800 gems as well. The Extra Life Karma Boosters can be obtained separately for 75 gems each or 275 gems for 5 boosters. Purchasing any of these items will also grant you the in-game title “The Extra Life” in blue text.

    All proceeds from these purchases will be donated to Children’s Miracle Network!

    Don’t forget to take a gander at the Extra Life campaign page for Team ArenaNet. On Friday, November 13, and Saturday, November 14, our team will be live from 9:00 a.m. until 9:00 p.m. Pacific Time (UTC-8); find us in Tyria or watch our Twitch Channel! More information can be found in the Extra Life blog.

    Black Lion Chest Update: Flowing Music Chest

    Inside each chest, you’re guaranteed to find a redeemable Black Lion Statuette, a Mini Brown Terrier Pup, and two common items. You also have a chance to find something rarer in the fifth slot, including special items, glyphs, and skins from the Thundercrag Weapon Collection and Dragon Essence Weapon Collection.

    The Mini Brown Terrier Pup is part of a new Black Lion Mini Collection. This collection includes miniatures such as the Mini Celestial Terrier Pup, Mini Blazing Terrier Pup, and Mini Black and White Terrier Pup.

    Exclusive Item: Music Box Chair

    Become a living music box figurine and dance with the grace of a ballerina. Your beautiful elegance and poise will be a sight to behold! The Music Box Chair Skin is a new, exclusive drop from Black Lion Chests.

    What’s in Stock

    Friday, November 13, we’re rotating our stock of mount adoption licenses and packs at 20% off. This offer will be available until November 27. Some favorites to consider: Mad Realm Mounts Pack, Mad King Mounts Pack, Spooky Mounts Pack, Warclaw Frontline Mount Pack, Tenacious Creatures Mount Licenses, and Janthir Caprine Warclaw Pack.

    Returning This Week

    Make sure to grab what you need from our selection of amazing discounted items! From today until November 17, Material Storage Expanders, Recharging Teleport to Friend devices, Black Lion Expedition Boards, and Black Lion Garden Plot Deeds are available at a 20% discount!

  • Available Now in the Gem Store!

    Log into Guild Wars 2 and press 'O' to access the Black Lion Trading Company for these great offers and more!

item.title: Announcing Guild Wars Afterlife—Prepurchase Available Now!
item.dc:creator: The Guild Wars 2 Team
item.description:
A new DLC for the original Guild Wars is coming in January!

Read More
item.content:encoded:
Over the past year, the original Guild Wars® has undergone quite a transformation. Galvanized by the support of our incredible community and bolstered by our partnership with 2weeks, Guild Wars Reforged was born. This brought new life to our 21-year-old game, complete with regular new content updates, a new dungeon, and a launch onto mobile platforms—a first for ArenaNet®.

Today, we’re announcing Guild Wars Afterlife™, the first new DLC for the game in almost 20 years! Before we tell you all about it, check out our announcement trailer:

Welcome to Xotecha

In Guild Wars Afterlife, you are called to the isle of Xotecha, deep within the Mists, to join the Order of the Moonless Night. The Order watches over the Unformed, a jungle of shared dreams where memory is made manifest. It is here where they serve as shepherds for wayward spirits guiding them toward reconciliation with any unresolved tragedies and regret from their lives. Any spirit who lingers in their anguish for too long risks being overtaken by their pain, causing a terrible transformation into beings of pure rage, Nightmares.

Recently, throngs of lost souls have flooded the Unformed, and a mysterious cult has begun meddling in the affairs of the afterlife. Overwhelmed and missing one of their elders, the Order of the Moonless Night enlists your aid before they are overrun with Nightmares. Will you answer their call?

A New Way to Play Guild Wars

In Guild Wars Afterlife, you’ll adventure into Xotecha with your existing characters, but you’ll get to play them in ways that you’ve never experienced before. As you seek to assist the Order of the Moonless Night, you’ll enter an ever-changing dungeon called the Unformed.

No two trips into the Unformed are ever the same. After selecting a starting loadout, you’ll face a unique lineup of maps, encounters, and bosses as the Mists weave lost memories around you. In addition, we’re introducing a skill-drafting system that lets you choose new abilities as you progress. The skills offered during these choices are not limited to your primary and secondary professions, so the possibilities are endless!

As you complete runs, you’ll unlock both rewards that impact future dungeon runs and permanent rewards you can enjoy outside of Xotecha. In addition, with each venture into the Unformed, the story of Afterlife will unfold.

Guild Wars Afterlife Arrives Early Next Year

Guild Wars Afterlife* is slated to launch on PC, Steam, Apple App Store, and Google Play on January 13, 2027. Prepurchase now at a discounted price of 23.99 USD/EUR (actual discounted price may vary by platform/location), which includes the ancestral-themed Vestments of the Order costume today as a bonus! At launch, Guild Wars Afterlife will return to its standard price of 29.99 USD/EUR.

*Requires Guild Wars Reforged to play.

Key features

  • Skill-Drafting Combat: Build a custom skill bar unique to each run, utilizing abilities from any profession for boundless replayability.
  • New Dynamic Dungeon: Explore jungles, cenotes, and floating ruins in an ever-changing dungeon format.
  • All-New Story: Uncover the history of Xotecha deep within the Mists, where memories and dreams bleed into reality.
  • Unlock New Rewards: Play with your existing characters to collect rewards that impact future dungeon runs and permanent rewards that you can enjoy outside of Xotecha.
  • New Allies and New Foes: Encounter Ancient Golems, battle powerful Nightmares, and uncover the secrets of the Cult of Odran.
  • Play with Friends: Embark on dungeon runs with your friends or with henchmen.

Twenty-one years after launch, our first game is getting brand-new downloadable content. Guild Wars Afterlife exists because of you, our community, and we can’t wait for you to play it early next year.

—The ArenaNet Team
